key.name: enabled
key.summary: Use the touch keyboard
key.description: Off: GNOME Shell's own on-screen keyboard.

key.name: mode
key.summary: Layout: compact (letters, digits and symbols on their own pages) or Hacker's Keyboard's full one

key.name: bar
key.summary: The bar over the keys: the layout switch, word suggestions, Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, the arrows

key.name: bar-scale
key.summary: The bar's height, in percent of a row of keys

key.name: height-portrait
key.summary: Keyboard height in portrait, percent of the screen height

key.name: height-landscape
key.summary: Keyboard height in landscape, percent of the screen height

key.name: top-row-scale
key.summary: Height of the number row, percent of a row

key.name: extension-row
key.summary: Show the F1-F12 row above the number row

key.name: bottom-padding
key.summary: Empty space under the keys, pixels

key.name: style
key.summary: Colors of the keys

key.name: key-gap
key.summary: Space between keys, pixels (taps in it still hit the key)

key.name: key-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the keys, pixels

key.name: key-borders
key.summary: Draw the keys as raised buttons; off: flat labels

key.name: label-scale
key.summary: Size of the key labels, percent

key.name: key-preview
key.summary: Show the pressed key enlarged above the finger

key.name: long-press-ms
key.summary: Long press delay for the alternate characters, milliseconds

key.name: repeat-delay-ms
key.summary: Hold time before a repeatable key repeats, milliseconds

key.name: repeat-interval-ms
key.summary: Interval of the key repeat, milliseconds

key.name: haptics
key.summary: Vibrate on key press

key.name: haptic-ms
key.summary: Vibration length, milliseconds

key.name: touch-offset
key.summary: Move touches up by this many pixels (fingers land below the key they aim at)

key.name: hysteresis
key.summary: A sliding finger leaves its key only this many pixels past the edge

key.name: swipe-up
key.summary: Swipe up over the keyboard

key.name: swipe-down
key.summary: Swipe down over the keyboard

key.name: swipe-left
key.summary: Swipe left over the keyboard

key.name: swipe-right
key.summary: Swipe right over the keyboard

key.name: space-cursor
key.summary: Slide along the space bar to move the cursor

key.name: suggestions
key.summary: Word suggestions in the bar
key.description: Completions of the word being typed and, after a space, the likeliest next words; never in password, terminal, address or number fields.

key.name: languages
key.summary: The dictionaries of the suggestions, the preferred one first

key.name: learn
key.summary: Learn from what is typed
key.description: The words and word pairs typed are kept, privately, in the user's data directory and suggested first; a long press on a suggestion forgets it.
